name: environment
prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: final playable game background, landscape 3:2.
Image 1 is ONLY an exact geometric layout guide. Images 2 and 3 are ONLY visual style references, not content to copy. Repaint the layout of Image 1 into a polished original Chinese nostalgic life-simulation game illustration. Keep the camera, perspective, room floor corners, back wall, wide central doorway gap and concourse/road boundaries geometrically identical to Image 1.
Style must closely match the reference screenshots: delicate dark-brown pencil/ink contours with varied thin line weight; softly painted gouache and watercolor shading; believable worn surfaces, tiny lived-in details; warm muted ochre, dusty jade, faded coral, khaki and walnut. Semi-realistic illustrated architectural scale. This is detailed hand-painted game art, not flat vector art, chibi cartoon, thick black outlines or a 3D render.
Scene: a small late-1980s/1990s Chinese diner inside a retro department-store mall at evening. The diner is an open-roof cutaway upper center/right. Cream plaster upper walls, dusty jade lower walls, wood-framed shelves with ceramic bowls, jars, faded food posters, a little wall clock, electric conduit, fluorescent tubes and a ceiling fan. Its rectangular deep-green sign at the indicated back-wall location is BLANK, no lettering. The restaurant floor is warm worn ochre ceramic tiles, with a clear EMPTY central service area. Paint realistic shading and tile wear. The front boundary remains LOW cutaway walls with the central gap fully open and unobstructed; no giant freestanding door portal.
Outside the diner is a continuous INDOOR RETRO MALL CONCOURSE, not a rural street. Paint fixed built-in wooden and metal-framed storefronts into the side perimeter bands in the guide: bookstore, flower shop, tea shop with stocked display shelves, old glass cabinets, fabric awnings, blank cream signboards. Add period-appropriate mall architectural depth, corner columns, warm tube lamps, plant arrangements at perimeter and indoor terrazzo/floral tile details. Large clear mall glazing separates the lower foreground concourse from a strip of asphalt ROAD OUTSIDE. Keep the concourse lane across the image unobstructed. Paint the road empty, as moving vehicles will be added in code. No physical sky inside the mall; surround the composition with believable continuous mall architecture and flooring, avoiding floating isolated diorama against a gradient.
Layer constraints: NO people, NO animals, NO cars; NO dining tables or chairs; NO kitchen counters or stovetops, these are separate movable sprites. Shelves/posters wall decoration are allowed. No UI, no buttons, no coins, no interface frames, no watermark, NO visible text, NO guide labels or English words. Keep wall/floor structure crisp enough to align moving actors and props to the provided geometric guide. Fill the entire canvas with finished art.

name: props
prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: production game prop sprite atlas on true transparent alpha.
The two inputs are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY. Create ORIGINAL assets with the same detailed nostalgic Chinese life-simulation hand-painted appearance: thin variable brown ink contours, softly painted realistic wood/metal/fabric/ceramic textures, muted dusty jade/ochre/walnut/coral palette, subtle contact shadows. Do not copy logos or specific designs. NO thick black outline, flat vector symbols, chibi art or 3D rendering.
STRICT ATLAS: exactly FOUR columns and FOUR rows, 16 equal square cells, preferably 2048x2048 overall. No lines separating cells, no labels. Each object isolated within its own cell with at least 12% transparent padding on all sides; centered horizontally and its ground/contact point at 88% cell height. Consistent orthographic map view, camera looks DOWN at about 32 degrees from southeast; long furniture front edges slope down toward screen-right approximately 25 degrees, side edges up toward screen-right approximately 40 degrees, matching the first reference's map.
Cell order, row-major:
Row 1: 1 wooden kitchen preparation cabinet with detailed cutting board, vegetables, knife and drawers; 2 old double gas range with one metal soup pot and one wok, realistic knobs and kettle; 3 wooden plating dresser with ceramic plates, bowls, small condiment jars and shelves; 4 worn enamel and stainless sink cabinet with faucet, washbasin, dish rack.
Row 2: 5 small square/rectangular wooden dining table ALONE, long axis parallel to front cabinet edges, no chairs, with simple tissue and chopstick holder; 6 simple wooden dining chair seen from back/left, facing toward screen-right; 7 matching dining chair seen from front/right, facing screen-left; 8 cashier's narrow wooden counter with period cash register, paper ledger, drawers and a small red telephone.
Row 3: 9 leafy potted indoor plant in ceramic planter; 10 small wooden A-frame restaurant menu sign with BLANK chalkboard; 11 small orange-and-white cat walking to screen-right, left front paw forward; 12 SAME cat, opposite paws forward.
Row 4: 13 small friendly tan mixed-breed dog walking to screen-right, first step; 14 SAME dog, opposite step; 15 small silver late-1980s hatchback in same isometric view, length parallel to world front edges, nose toward screen-right; 16 muted cream/red 1990s sedan in same isometric view and direction.
Maintain exact cell count and order, clearly separated transparent gaps, all objects complete and uncropped. No people except pets in their cells. No background floor, backdrop, scenery, UI, text, border or watermark. Actual transparent background.

name: people-front
prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: walking character sprite atlas on true transparent alpha for a map-view Chinese restaurant management game.
Input screenshots are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY. Create original characters closely matching their visual language: hand-drawn Chinese slice-of-life comic / nostalgic game illustrations, normal slender human anatomy around 6.5 heads tall for adults, expressive but modest-sized eyes, defined noses and faces, individual hair strands, subtle cloth folds, soft cel/gouache shading and fine brown ink lines. Muted 1980s/1990s everyday Chinese clothes. Do NOT make bobbleheads, short-legged chibi, generic flat-vector figures, sticker emojis, heavy black outlines or 3D models.
STRICT ATLAS GRID: FOUR columns and SIX rows, 24 identical square cells, portrait 2:3 aspect. Each full-body person isolated on true transparent alpha; no gridlines, labels, background, UI or shadows extending beyond its cell. Center each figure x=50% of its cell, feet baseline y=90%, head near y=9%, clear transparent margins. All figures viewed from an orthographic elevated 32-degree southeast camera matching the map reference, in natural THREE-QUARTER FRONT view facing and walking toward screen-right/down-right. Two adjacent cells show two walk-cycle phases of the EXACT SAME person, same scale and clothes: phase A left foot forward, phase B right foot forward; torso and head remain stable.
Rows with left pair (columns1/2) and right pair (columns3/4):
Row1: young Chinese man, blue-white striped short-sleeve shirt and dark trousers; young Chinese woman, cream blouse and muted coral skirt, shoulder-length black hair.
Row2: Chinese boy about 8, jade short-sleeve shirt and khaki shorts; Chinese girl about 8, light yellow top and dusty red pinafore, two braids. Child anatomy about 5 heads tall.
Row3: elderly Chinese man, wispy gray hair, pale undershirt and loose brown trousers, slightly stooped; elderly Chinese woman, gray bun, plum patterned blouse and dark sage trousers.
Row4: adult Chinese office man, white short-sleeve shirt and navy trousers, holding a small briefcase; adult Chinese office woman, pale blue blouse and dark skirt, tied-back hair, handbag.
Row5: restaurant owner/chef man age 35, white chef cap, white rolled sleeves, dark blue apron and trousers; waitress young woman, cream shirt, sage apron and dark skirt.
Row6: cleaner middle-aged woman, muted blue work jacket, dark apron and gray trousers; artist young man, loose tan overshirt, sage trousers, canvas shoulder bag.
Every person complete head-to-toe, consistent thin-line painted art, rich individual facial and clothing details. Exactly 24 sprites. Actual transparent background, no baked labels or frame borders.
